gems.title: 欢迎来龙餐馆
gems.titleEn: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
gems.summary: 徐福为养家还债远赴中东中餐馆当厨师，在当地结识了大堂经理马俊生。他们以地道中国风味广招八方来客，龙餐馆声名鹊起。然而随着战争爆发，当地形势急转直下，没有人能够独善其身，徐福和马俊生也不例外，他们的命运将何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
gems.summaryEn: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds w
gems.whyWatch: 战争烟火下的中国餐馆，小人物命运与家国情怀交织，被低估的华语佳作。
gems.whyWatchEn: A Chinese restaurant in a war zone becomes a microcosm of human resilience—a gripping, underrated war drama.
gems.audience: 喜欢战争史诗与现实主义叙事的影迷。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of war epics and grounded humanist storytelling.

gems.title: 维什瓦纳特父子
gems.summary: 桑贾伊·维什瓦纳特是一位备受赞誉的专业手枪射击运动员，年过四十，在名利场上可谓功成名就。然而，当他与二十多岁的女孩玛迪相遇后，两人之间因较大的年龄差距产生了种种碰撞与问题，迫使他们不得不重新审视并坦然面对。
gems.summaryEn: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that th
gems.whyWatch: 中年射击冠军与年轻女孩的忘年恋，在传统与欲望间展开动人挣扎。
gems.whyWatchEn: A celebrated middle-aged shooter and a young woman confront age and expectation in this tender, culturally rich romance.
gems.audience: 偏好跨国情感故事和细腻角色塑造的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who enjoy cross-cultural love stories and nuanced character studies.

gems.title: 属于我的孩子
gems.summary: 在这部令人震惊的纪录片中，承受家人和社会的期望的女子迫切地想要个孩子，因此假装怀孕，并卷入一起犯罪。
gems.summaryEn: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
gems.whyWatch: 假怀孕到犯罪，纪录片揭示生育执念如何吞噬人性。
gems.whyWatchEn: A chilling documentary about a woman's fake pregnancy and crime, exposing the desperate pressure to have a child.
gems.audience: 关注女性议题与真实罪案纪录片的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in women's issues and true-crime documentaries.

gems.title: 我们未曾有过的
gems.summary: 改编自爱丽丝·凯伦（Alice Kellen）同名畅销小说。失去父母后，有志成为画家的利亚（Leah）难以应对。当她的哥哥搬走后，他请最好的朋友阿克塞尔（Axel）照顾她，却不知道她对他一直以来的感情。
gems.summaryEn: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grap
gems.whyWatch: 畅销小说改编，暗恋、成长与失去的青春挽歌。
gems.whyWatchEn: A poignant adaptation of Alice Kellen's novel—an emotional tale of secret love, grief, and coming-of-age.
gems.audience: 喜欢青春纯爱和催泪故事的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of bittersweet YA romance and emotional drama.

gems.title: 重器
gems.summary: 以改革开放初期至1997年《刑诉法》《刑法》修订为背景，讲述陈一众、余高远、张丽慧、夏英杰等法学院毕业生在不同司法岗位上历经风雨、共同见证中国法治发展进程的故事，展现他们在时代浪潮中成长、抉择与命运交织的群像篇章。
gems.summaryEn: In the early years of China's reform and opening-up, five law school graduates—Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Lu Zeming, Xia Yingjie, and Zhang Lihui—embarked on diverse careers within the judicial system.
gems.whyWatch: 法治进程中的司法群像，国产正剧的厚重与温度兼备。
gems.whyWatchEn: A sweeping Chinese legal drama tracing young lawyers through decades of judicial reform—dense, earnest and absorbing.
gems.audience: 喜欢历史变迁与职业群像剧的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of historical transformation and workplace ensemble dramas.

gems.title: 花开锦绣
gems.summary: 豪爽重情的私盐贩子赵凌虽出身草莽，却心怀壮志，他结识了遭人诬陷私通的世家名媛小姐傅庭芸，被迫一起逃亡，二人历经家族与朝廷的重重考验，与命运抗争，终成传奇良缘。
gems.summaryEn: After being falsely accused of a scandal that ruins her reputation, noblewoman Fu Tingyun escapes with the help of salt smuggler Zhao Ling. Together, they expose government corruption and navigate the
gems.whyWatch: 私盐贩与世家女的传奇爱恋，古装剧里难得一见的鲜活与热血。
gems.whyWatchEn: A smuggler and a noblewoman's unlikely romance brings vivid energy and old-school charm to costume drama.
gems.audience: 喜爱古装传奇与强情节爱情故事的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who love costume legends and sweeping love stories.

gems.title: 斯图尔特未能拯救宇宙
gems.titleEn: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
gems.summary: 故事聚焦《大爆炸》的漫画书老板斯图尔特·布鲁姆，他弄坏了一个谢尔顿和莱纳德制造的设备，意外导致了多元宇宙的世界末日，他必须与女友Denise、地质学家Bert和量子物理学家Barry一起去将现实复原。一路上，他们遇到了平行宇宙版本的各个《大爆炸》角色，事情进展并不顺利。
gems.summaryEn: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.
gems.whyWatch: 从《生活大爆炸》衍生出的多元宇宙喜剧，脑洞与笑点齐飞。
gems.whyWatchEn: A hilarious Big Bang Theory spinoff that turns a comic-book store owner into a hapless multiverse savior—fresh and wildly fun.
gems.audience: 喜欢情景喜剧和科幻恶搞的轻松观众。
gems.audienceEn: Sitcom fans and anyone who loves sci-fi comedy with heart.

gems.title: 诛仙
gems.summary: 一夜间惨变孤儿的张小凡被青云门收为弟子，经过五年刻苦修炼，他在师门七脉会武上大放异彩，后被派往空桑山打探魔教行迹，旅程中，他与师姐陆雪琪遭遇危难，并结识救护了魔教女子碧瑶，同时，新的危险也在前方等待着他。
gems.summaryEn: Zhang Xiaofan, who turned into an orphan overnight, becomes a disciple of the Qingyun Sect. After five years of training, he performs well in the Seven Peak Martial Arts Competition. He's sent to the
gems.whyWatch: 国漫仙侠扛鼎之作，少年张小凡的成长与情义刻画得荡气回肠。
gems.whyWatchEn: A standout Chinese animated xianxia saga—Boy Zhang Xiaofan's journey through love, loyalty and destiny is epic and emotional.
gems.audience: 国漫爱好者和仙侠世界观拥趸。
gems.audienceEn: Chinese animation fans and xianxia fantasy lovers.
